paragraphs.text: ChatGPT Pass: ChatGPT subscription models and account settings for DeepSeek Harness
ChatGPT Pass
English · 简体中文
Use authorized ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness with `dsh-chatgpt-pass`. This plugin
provides account connections, a model catalog, streaming text, local function tools, and remaining s
ubscription quota when available.
This is an independently maintained third-party plugin, not an official OpenAI or DeepSeek plugin. V
alidated Harness versions are **0.2.1-rc.5** and **0.2.2-rc.1**. Other versions have not been verifi
dated Harness versions are **0.2.1-rc.5** and **0.2.2-rc.1**. Other versions have not been verified.
## Installation
Download `dsh-chatgpt-pass-<version>.tgz` and its `.sha256` file from Releases. Add the local packag
e in the Harness plugin manager and enable it. Release packages are prebuilt; users do not need to i
nstall Node.js separately, clone the source, or run build scripts.
Current package: v0.2.19. If your plugin manager accepts download links, you can paste this `.tgz` U
RL directly. This project is distributed through GitHub Releases and is not currently published on n
directly. This project is distributed through GitHub Releases and is not currently published on npm.
For CLI installation, replace the profile and filename with your actual values:

See the installation guide (Chinese) for installation, upgrades, removal, and compatibility details.
## Preview
The sidebar shows the five-hour quota; click it to open usage details. The image uses demonstration
idebar shows the five-hour quota; click it to open usage details. The image uses demonstration data.
The account and quota shown above are demonstration data. The settings page currently uses Chinese l
abels; their English meanings are provided below.
## Sign in and use models
Open **Settings → ChatGPT 订阅 (ChatGPT Subscription)** and choose a connection:
| Entry | Recommended accounts | Connection |

| ChatGPT 登录 (ChatGPT login) | Plus / Pro | Official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC) flow |
| Business 登
录 (Business login) | Business / Team | Experimental Codex compatibility route |
Complete authorization on the official browser page, return to Harness, and choose an available mode
l in the chat model picker. Once connected, expand **切换连接方式 (Switch connection method)** to sign in
again, or **可用模型 (Available models)** to view and refresh the catalog.
Codex connections can show the remaining quota and reset countdown for five-hour and weekly windows.
When the official connection does not provide quota data, the page shows an empty state rather than
estimating usage. Account-wide historical token analytics are not currently available.
Enable **在侧边栏显示余量 (Show quota in sidebar)** to show only the five-hour remaining quota in a compact
entry above the main sidebar's account/settings control. Click it to open a detail popover with five
-hour and weekly limits, reset countdowns, and refresh. **订阅设置 (Subscription settings)** closes the
popover and opens this plugin's ChatGPT Subscription page inside Harness. Click outside or press Esc
ape to close. The option defaults to off, is saved in Harness configuration, updates about once a mi
nute while visible, and hides when the sidebar collapses.
**The Business compatibility route is not a third-party integration supported by OpenAI's documentat
ion.** It uses the first-party Codex OAuth client and may be affected by workspace policies, terms o
f service, or interface changes. Use only accounts and workspaces you are authorized to access. Elig
ibility, models, and actual limits depend on the authorization result.

Further documentation:

process (Chinese)

## Limitations and credentials
- Currently supports text and ordinary local function tools; full multimodal support is not guarante

ed.
- Real Plus / Pro inference has not been verified. The Business compatibility route has been ver

ified with real text and tool rounds. Automated tests do not establish account eligibility.
- Only o
ne connection is active at a time. Switching methods requires signing in again and replaces the curr

ent connection.
- Credentials are stored by the Harness credentials service, not in plugin configura
tion, browser state, or distribution packages. The plugin does not read other applications' login ca

ches or fall back to API-key billing.
- After signing out locally, you can manage remote authorizati
on in ChatGPT usage and permissions settings.
